description: ParaEMT (NLR's (formerly known as NREL's) EMT Simulator: An Open Source, and HPC-Compatible Large-Scale Power System Electro-Magnetic Transient (EMT) Simulator) [SWR-22-16] is a software deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Jin Tan, Bin Wang (National Renewable Energy Lab. (NREL), Golden, CO (United States)). This open-source tool aims to provide a flexible platform for simulating electromagnetic transients (EMT) of large-scale inverter-based resource (IBR)-dominated power systems. The purpose of making it open source is to support a community of EMT simulation and assist in exploring new EMT algorithms and applying advanced computational techniques to EMT simulation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
